Projects saved by FL Studio 26.1.1 on the development Mac, made for these tests (driven with synthetic mouse and
keyboard input; FL Studio itself wrote every byte):

* `lime-steps.flp` — Default template (130 BPM, 808 kit routed to inserts 1–5); Kick on steps 1/5/9/13, Clap on
  5/13, HiHat on every other step, nothing in the Playlist.
* `lime-notes.flp` — Default template plus a 3x Osc channel (channel 6). Pattern 1, in the Piano roll: C5 (key 60)
  at step 1 for 4 steps, velocity 34 %; E5 at step 5 for 2 steps; G5 at step 9 for 8 steps, velocity 98 %; C4 at
  step 17 for 16 steps. A second pattern named "Bassline": C4 at step 1 and A#3 at step 5, each one bar long.
* `lime-arrange.flp` — `lime-notes.flp` arranged in the Playlist: Pattern 1 at bars 1 and 5 of Track 1, Bassline at
  bar 3 of Track 2 and at bar 9 of Track 3 (muted with the mute tool), the "DL Breaker" loop dragged from the
  browser (Packs › Loops) to bar 3 of Track 5, and an automation clip of DL Breaker's panning (right-click the
  knob › Create automation clip) on Track 4 from bar 1. Then the tempo was typed in as 128 and the time signature
  set to 3/4 in Options › Project general settings (bar numbers above are 4/4 bars, placed before the change).
